similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic Kiyomizu-dera Niomon gate. It features the massive stone base platform, the grand central staircase, the main vermilion wooden gate structure with detailed columns and beams, the double-layered curved hip-and-gable roofs (using frustum_pyramid with topR < botR to ensure correct outward-downward slope), the central decorative spire (sorin), and the front stone lanterns and protective railings. All parts are tightly integrated to form a solid, closed volume with symmetrical backing.
